hypothesis: RGB can identify explicit jointly visible obstacle-floor contact, then known rays/current causal IMU/encoder pose plus disclosed floor prior locate 2D risk without a learned depth scale.
new_target_vs_old: Direct witnessed interface labels; all contact pixels rather than lowest appearance-positive pixel. Separate obstacle/floor witnesses. No old distance/semantic/BEV model weights.
collection: Frozen historical requests used only as predetermined drive excitation; native PID ideal bank feedback retained. No source model/control selection inference, no navigation performance claim. No teleports/internal resets/scene changes.
early_stop: After e0 complete, perform whole-sequence GT-only necessary oracle and causal-pose consumer gates. On failure close candidate and do not collect e1 or fit.
termination: At end of frozen request program, or the first 0.1-second request block whose native contact latch is true. The inherited executor completes the current five-tick block (up to four additional 0.02-second ticks after contact) before capture/stop. Preserve every contact and tick. A legal acquisition end, not navigation success.
initial_gauge: Known initial position/orientation calibration privileged once; live pose from native gyro/acceleration/main encoder only; low-level bank feedback uses ideal current quaternion and is disclosed.

oracle.target_domain: All finite range .5–3m, nonCAD, outside root .55m, world height .05–1.5m GT visible cells. Full sphere/cylinder visible targets retained, including suspended objects.
oracle.source_geometry: Exact actual runtime primitive floor-plane intersection, cylinders or spheres; objects whose bottom is above floor have no contact target and stay unknown. Buried/intersecting vs base-on-floor vs suspended reported separately. Unsupported render surfaces remain unknown and in full denominator.
oracle.causal_pose_consumer_gate: The same contact labels must pass precision>=.95, full-visible target recall>=.8, XY cell P90<=.15 with native IMU/encoder estimated camera transforms; truth used only for labels/scoring. Record inherited begin/end timestamp phase lag; no online correction using truth.
oracle.empty_target_handling: No target and no projection => N/A frame, counts retained; any projected cells with no true target are false positives; visible target with no projection has recall0. No omitted suspended/unknown cells.

model_frozen.input: Independent current RGB+calibrated ray x/y+current estimated camera gravity3+current estimated camera height (9 channels), each eye shared model
model_frozen.output: One contact logit per pixel, raw image axes; no depth/GT/future/other-camera network input
model_frozen.train_normalization: RGB [0,1], fixed ray/gravity/height scales; no holdout statistics
model_frozen.prediction_rule: p>=.8 and local maximum along current projected gravity within +/-2 original pixels; current CAD exclusion; no bottommost-column selection
model_frozen.heldout_group: Entire e0 new trajectory; no e0 fitting or hyperparameter/model changes
model_frozen.train_group: Entire e1 new trajectory, only if preceding gates pass

stop_rules: No rejected model inference/revival or old budgets reopened
No GT contact labels used online
Geometry/data/pose gate fail => no fit or navigation
acquisition_count_contract: At most2 distinct initial trajectory acquisitions plus at most1 environment recovery; every launch including recovery consumes the total physical_cap4. No extra navigation if the total budget cannot cover required controls.
recovery: One interface/environment recovery only. CameraParams attaches before formal reset priming; eight fixed render-only refreshes at unchanged physical clock before strict atomic capture. Preserve first failed start and all scientific gates.
